note: Cases for validate_controls_handled (final_program.rs): a control reaches the rendering trait and its hosts plus every listens route out of them. Controls are the std-orb-fired-events byControl answer, hosts the std-orb-embed-chain answer. Controls: handled by the renderer, handled by a host, delivered by a trait-source or any-source listens, a definerKnob offer, no controls. Reds: nothing handles it, a non-embedding handler, a listens route from a different source. Forwards (CONTROLS_FORWARDED): the unhandled controls whose emit for the event carries scope external with scopeOverridden, what an importer must route; an atom's own external declaration or another event's override forwards nothing.
